recommendations.innovation_title: Advanced Organic Acid Hydrometallurgy for EV Cathode Precursors
recommendations.reuse_pathway: Transforms Spent Lithium Battery Black Mass via Organic Acid Hydrometallurgy into high-value EV Cathode Precursors feedstocks.
recommendations.technical_summary: Scientific evidence demonstrates that Spent Lithium Battery Black Mass can be processed using Organic Acid Hydrometallurgy. Supporting research confirms recovery of active components with strong economic value and zero waste discharge.

supporting_research_papers.title: Closed-Loop Hydrometallurgical Recycling of Spent Lithium-Ion Battery Cathodes using Organic Acid Leaching
supporting_research_papers.key_finding: Citric acid-hydrogen peroxide leaching achieves >98% recovery of Lithium, Cobalt, and Nickel from spent battery black mass with zero toxic emissions.

supporting_research_papers.title: Valorisation of Citrus Waste: Microwave-Assisted Extraction of Pectin and Bio-active Compounds
supporting_research_papers.key_finding: Microwave-assisted extraction yields high-purity pectin (up to 28% dry weight) and D-limonene solvent substitutes from citrus peel waste.

supporting_patents.title: Direct Regeneration and Resynthesis of Cathode Active Materials from Spent Battery Black Mass
supporting_patents.claim_summary: Claims direct hydrothermal re-lithiation and co-precipitation of NCM cathode precursor directly from leach liquor without intermediate metal crystallization.

industrial_benefits: Replaces virgin raw materials in EV Cathode Precursors production.
High economic valorization potential from Organic Acid Hydrometallurgy.
Reduces disposal tipping fees and hazardous liability.
environmental_benefits: Diverts Spent Lithium Battery Black Mass from industrial landfill tipping.
Significantly lowers scope 3 carbon footprint compared to virgin extraction.
processing_requirements: Pre-treatment and sorting of Spent Lithium Battery Black Mass.
Implementation of Organic Acid Hydrometallurgy processing unit.
Quality assurance testing for output specifications.
limitations: Feedstock purity must meet process tolerance limits.
Requires initial capital expenditure for processing equipment.
